questions.stem: A two-way table shows $15$ boys play football and $10$ boys play rugby. $8$ girls play football and $12$ girls play rugby. What is the probability that a randomly chosen student is a girl who plays rugby?
questions.explanation: Total students $= 15 + 10 + 8 + 12 = 45$. Girls who play rugby $= 12$. $P = \frac{12}{45} = \frac{4}{15}$.
